title: The Small Wardrobe
author: Wren Dravenmoor
blurb: Marguerite Sterling, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
